name: Slider
description: A carousel of images with optional title, text and button per slide. Without JavaScript it is a snapping horizontal scroller; Embla adds paging, arrows and dots.

perView.description: Slides visible at once on wide screens.

caption.description: Caption under the image, or over its lower edge on a gradient.

slides.label: Slides

imageAlt.label: Image description
imageAlt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it.

text.label: Text
text.description: A line or two under the heading.

ctaLabel.label: Button label
ctaLabel.description: Button text; the slide has no button without it.

slides.description: Slides: the image's address and text, and an optional link (ctaLabel + ctaHref).

loop.description: Wrap from the last slide to the first.

a11y: WAI-ARIA carousel pattern: a labelled region with aria-roledescription=carousel, slides as labelled groups ('Slide 2 of 5'), labelled previous/next buttons disabled at the ends, and dot buttons marking the current slide. No autoplay; with prefers-reduced-motion slides change without animation. Without JavaScript every slide is reachable by scrolling.
